job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer with expertise in Python, FastAPI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered automation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and developing GenAI solutions, integrating local/open-source LLMs, building intelligent document processing workflows, and developing scalable backend APIs. This role requires close collaboration with QA and business teams to deliver secure, accurate, and enterprise-ready AI solutions.




Mandatory Skills

Strong proficiency in Python for AI application development, automation, and data processing.
Hands-on experience with FastAPI for developing RESTful APIs.
Experience working with Generative AI (GenAI) technologies and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Hands-on experience integrating Ollama and local/open-source LLMs.
Understanding of Prompt Engineering, LLM inference, and AI workflow orchestration.
Good understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals, including:
Classification
Anomaly Detection
Smart Matching
Experience with REST API integration and JSON-based data exchange.
Strong knowledge of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
Experience with OCR technologies for extracting structured information from documents and images.
Strong proficiency in Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
Strong debugging, logging, and troubleshooting skills.
Experience using Git for version control.



Preferred Skills

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Vector Databases.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar GenAI frameworks.
Knowledge of embedding models and semantic search.
Experience with Text Classification and Anomaly Detection.
Knowledge of the Financial/Reporting domain.
Exposure to Test Automation and collaboration with QA teams.
Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of audit trails, compliance, and enterprise AI governance.
Strong QA and validation skills to ensure AI output accuracy and business correctness.



Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using Python and FastAPI.
Integrate local/open-source LLMs using Ollama and build secure AI workflows.
Develop intelligent document processing solutions using OCR and GenAI.
Build RAG-based applications for document search and knowledge retrieval.
Implement prompt engineering techniques and optimize LLM performance.
Develop machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, and intelligent matching.
Design and integrate REST APIs with enterprise systems.
Validate data using SQL and implement reconciliation and reporting workflows.
Collaborate closely with QA and business stakeholders to ensure solution quality, accuracy, and enterprise readiness.
Follow best practices for debugging, logging, version control, and deployment
